findings: Eight brackets follow the SNL half-band assemblies: four MX49 and four MX47. Retainers are source-handed: low port lower/starboard upper; track port upper/starboard lower.

Four M348/M353 pins connect both rear brackets to the inboard M337 links. The interleaved single-lug construction, transverse stations, 24mm shafts, pin grooves and forked retaining springs are estimates.

Two MX82 spacers preserve printed0.189in ID,0.5in OD and0.375in thickness. Retainer rivets use the two printed3/16in stock lengths. Steel rear joints use eight3/8in rivets per MX49 and seven per MX47,60 total.

Sixteen lining rivets are replaced by quarter-inch x1-3/8 stock through the6.35mm feet. Borrowing later SNL fitting stock does not silently change the selected earlier segmented lining into the long-strip variant.

Rear half-gap5degrees, foot start159degrees, track lug inset6.35mm and retainer-stud offset5mm forward/19.05mm above anchor solve the tested static context. These are design estimates, not source measurements.

Rivet heads and upset profiles are approximations. The generators use the documented below-head stock-volume convention; the source listing alone does not establish the original forming operation or finished head dimensions.
Handbook coupling-set-screw service prose and the extra SNL MX49 quarter-inch button-rivet application remain unresolved. No service/removal sequence or complete historical joint layout is claimed.
Channel-registered overlays retain the earlier shaft/anchor residual: the modeled anchor is forward and below the pictured station. Hidden transverse layout is not established by a side elevation.
Front ears, adjusters, brake controls, high-speed brake fittings and support-foot fastening remain incomplete.
